input.command:
cd /tmp/mt-rep-2NSrou/repo; git add slug.py tests/test_slug.py; git commit -qm "Collapse whitespace runs in slugify

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"
W=.sdd/plan
mk(){ git diff -- slug.py > $W/task-1-mutant-$1.patch; test -s $W/task-1-mutant-$1.patch || echo EMPTY; git checkout -- slug.py; }
sed -i '' "s/r'\\\\s+'/r' '/" slug.py; mk 1   # only single space, no collapse
sed -i '' "s/r'\\\\s+'/r' +'/" slug.py; mk 2  # spaces only, not tabs/newlines
sed -i '' "s/title.lower()/title/" slug.py; mk 3  # no lowercase
sed -i '' "s/r'\\\\s+', '-'/r'\\\\s+', '--'/" slug.py; mk 4
sed -i '' "s/r'\\\\s+'/r'\\\\s{1,2}'/" slug.py; mk 5  # collapses only up to 2
sed -i '' "s/title.lower())/title.strip().lower())/" slug.py; mk 6 # strips edges
cat > $W/task-1-mutants.md <<'EOF'
